`advisory-synthetic.html` is a constructed page in the shape of an OpenJDK
Vulnerability Group advisory (a sentence naming the affected versions, an
OpenJDK risk matrix with a two-row header, an OpenJFX matrix after it). It
is not a copy of a real page: ids, versions and components are made up.
The converter is checked against real pages when they are curated.

`advisory-synthetic-emergency.html` is constructed in the shape of the real
pages curated on 2026-11-20 (CVE:F8b): the score and the vector share one
cell, and the affected versions carry a fifth element (`17.0.21.0.2`), as
emergency releases do. Ids are made up.
